# MEP — Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing

> MENASCO delivers integrated Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) engineering across every major building system — from HVAC and chilled-water plant to power distribution, water and drainage, and fire protection. Our in-house teams design, install, test and commission these systems as one coordinated scope, supported by BIM coordination from concept through handover.
